findings.value: A charity that runs an arts and events building on Old Street, EC1V, with performances, artist workshops and event hire. Time Out described it in 2016 as an 1865 building with experimental performance art and theatre.

evidence.quote: Did you know Shoreditch Town Hall is a charity?
Host your next event at Shoreditch Town Hall
Shoreditch Town Hall is a grand old 1865 building that fills its capacious rooms with a determinedly experimental collection of performance art and theatre shows.

findings.value: Its own site names schools, Hackney groups, volunteers and dancers among the people who take part.

evidence.quote: a Hackney group interested in using one of our spaces, a budding new volunteer

findings.value: Mainly theatre, dance and workshops: current listings include a tea dance, dance classes and a musical.

evidence.quote: Town Hall Tea Dance & Beginners' Dance Class Autumn 2026

notes: The venue's own site and Time Out (2016) are the only sources found. The 2016 Time Out text backs the summary history only. Trade news on theatreweekly.com about reopening and trustees is from 2020 or is not about status, so no status is proposed; the site lists events on sale for October and November 2026. Web search budget ran out before more press reviews could be checked.
